catalog.container_strategy: Use the unified selection manifest and a private local vendor overlay. Never publish payloads without component-specific redistribution clearance; no automatic license acceptance.

deployment.qualification_scope: Reference commands only. A reviewed local payload and installation receipt must supply exact executable paths, arguments, license admission and feature probes.
deployment.target_exports_policy: Explicit licensed component exports from the reviewed vendor receipt only; never copy a compiler toolkit or complete source/test corpus by default.

catalog.purpose: Collect AMD CPU hotspots, IBS, memory/cache, threading and system metrics.
qualification_gaps: A licensed local payload, exact delivered build identity, SHA-256, accepted license receipt and reviewed silent installation recipe are required.
The selected resource remains blocked until installation and real component probes succeed.
A physical target CPU, kernel, PMU and container launch profile must pass feature-specific collection probes; an installed executable is not full runtime qualification.
Official uProf 5.3 in-container collection requires SYS_ADMIN. IBS, OS tracing, power and EPYC-only PCM features have additional CPU/kernel/driver conditions.
DEB/RPM installation may run AMDuProfSetup.sh; do not let image builds configure the physical host. Prefer reviewed tar installation plus a separate host step.
catalog.size_basis: Exact installer size is unresolved; an authorized local import must record complete byte count and SHA-256.
